# 1_timeseriesAnalysis.Rmd#

#This script is to input all the data and run the rainbow plot, line plot, 
#changing point analysis, and phn level plot for a specified project.

```{r Initialise}
##setwd()

#######################r initialization####################
# Clear workspace
rm(list=ls()) 

# Load libraries
# Install required packages if not already installed
# install.packages(c( "spdep", "tmap", "epitools", "janitor", "lubridate"))
library(readr)        # For reading CSV files
library(tidyverse)    # For data manipulation and plotting
library(sf)           # For reading and handling spatial data
library(spdep)        # For spatial analysis, including Getis-Ord Gi*
library(epitools)     # For potential rate calculations (if needed)
library(janitor)      # For data cleaning
library(lubridate)    # For date manipulation
#library(knitr)        # For creating tables
library(kableExtra)   # For table formatting
library(dplyr)         # For data manipulation
library(ineq)

# Source to current directory and set working directory
basePath <- getwd()

# Restart R and set working directory to source file location. 

##r User inputs
##select project
selectedproject<- "2000_2024_changing_point"

# Various directories
projectFolder <- file.path(basePath,"projects", selectedproject)
codeFolder <- file.path(basePath,"code")
dataFolder <- file.path(basePath,"projects", selectedproject,"data")
resultsFolder <- file.path(basePath,"projects", selectedproject, "output")
figFolder <- file.path(basePath,"projects", selectedproject,"figures")
# HIV data folder - for sourcing latest notification cleaning files
HIVDataFolder <- file.path("C:", "onedrive", "OneDrive - UNSW", "HIV Trends Across Space and Time", 
  "General")

# Source
source(file.path(codeFolder, "Joinpoint_analysis.R"))
source(file.path(codeFolder, "Rainbow_plot_and_stats.R"))



```

```{r Input}
# Specify project input files and load them
hivdataFile<- file.path(HIVDataFolder, "hiv_data_cleaned_20250731.csv")
# Read the CSV data
hiv_data_all <- read_csv(hivdataFile, col_types = cols(
  month_hiv_diag = col_character(),
  age_hiv_notif = col_double(),
  sex = col_character(),
  gender = col_character(),
  region_birth = col_character(),
  au_birth = col_character(),
  lang_home = col_character(),
  year_arrival_aus = col_double(),
  cd4_count_diag = col_double(),
  late_hiv_diag_flag = col_logical(), 
  newly_acq_hiv_flag = col_logical(),
  hiv_exposure_risk = col_character(),
  place_acq = col_character(),
  state_res = col_character(),
  phn_res = col_character(),
  phn_name = col_character(),
  previ_diag_overseas = col_logical(),
  id = col_double(),
  year_diag = col_double()
))

hiv_data_all <- hiv_data_all %>%
  mutate(
    advanced_hiv_diag_flag = case_when(
      # If late_hiv_diag_flag is NA, return NA
       is.na(late_hiv_diag_flag) ~ NA,
      # If both conditions are met (cd4 < 200 AND late diagnosis), return TRUE
      cd4_count_diag < 200 & late_hiv_diag_flag == TRUE ~ TRUE,
      # All other cases return FALSE
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

hiv_data_all <- hiv_data_all %>%
  mutate(
    cd4_50_hiv_diag_flag = case_when(
      # If late_hiv_diag_flag is NA, return NA
      is.na(late_hiv_diag_flag)  ~ NA,
      # If both conditions are met (cd4 < 50 AND late diagnosis), return TRUE
      cd4_count_diag < 50 & late_hiv_diag_flag == TRUE ~ TRUE,
      # All other cases return FALSE
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

hiv_data <- hiv_data_all %>%
  filter(
    is.na(age_hiv_notif) | age_hiv_notif >= 18
  )

# Check data structure
str(hiv_data)

```

```{r rainbow plot}
#### cd4 trend ####
# Restrict to fed + non-missing CD4
hiv_cd4_fed <- hiv_data %>%
  filter(
    year_diag >= 2001,
    year_diag <= 2024,
    !is.na(year_diag),
    !is.na(cd4_count_diag),
    previ_diag_overseas == 0
  )

# Annual mean & median CD4
annual_cd4_summary <- hiv_cd4_fed %>%
  group_by(year_diag) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cd4   = mean(cd4_count_diag, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_cd4 = median(cd4_count_diag, na.rm = TRUE),
    n          = n(),              # optional: number of people each year
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(year = year_diag)

cd4_trends <- list(
  mean   = lm(mean_cd4 ~ year, data = annual_cd4_summary),
  median = lm(median_cd4 ~ year, data = annual_cd4_summary)
) %>%
  lapply(tidy) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "outcome")

cd4_time_plot <- ggplot(annual_cd4_summary, aes(x = year, y = median_cd4)) +
  geom_line(color = "#B696B6", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#B696B6", size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2001, 2024, 3)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 600),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +   # y-axis starts at 0
  labs(
    title = "",
    y = "CD4 count (cells/mm^3)",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),     # remove major gridlines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),     # remove minor gridlines
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),  # add black x & y axes
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"), # add tick marks
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  )
cd4_time_plot

# Save figure
if (!file.exists(file.path(figFolder, "cd4_time_plot_202511191.png"))) {
    SaveFigure(figFolder,"cd4_time_plot_20251119", cd4_time_plot,
               width = 20, height = 10)
}
```

```{r line plot}
####Function to create a line plot of HIV notifications and proportion of late HIV diagnosis####
create_dual_line_plot <- function(data,
                                 start_year = NULL,
                                 end_year = NULL,
                                 exposure_filter = NULL,      # hiv_exposure_risk
                                 gender_filter = NULL,        # gender
                                 region_birth_filter = NULL,  # region_birth
                                 lang_home_filter = NULL,     # lang_home
                                 place_acq_filter = NULL,     # place_acq
                                 state_res_filter = NULL,     # state_res
                                 phn_res_filter = NULL,       # phn_res
                                 year_var = "year_diag",
                                 late_diag_var = "late_hiv_diag_flag",
                                 main_title = "HIV Notifications and Late Diagnosis Proportion",
                                 subtitle = NULL,
                                 notification_color = "steelblue",
                                 late_diag_color = "firebrick",
                                 add_points = TRUE,
                                 add_labels = TRUE,
                                 legend_position = "bottom") {
  
  # Load required libraries
  require(tidyverse)
  require(scales)
  
  # Clone the data to avoid modifying the original
  plot_data <- data %>% as.data.frame()
  
  # Filter by year if specified
  if (!is.null(start_year)) {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
      filter(!!sym(year_var) >= start_year)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(end_year)) {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
      filter(!!sym(year_var) <= end_year)
  }
  
  # Apply filters based on various demographic variables
  if (!is.null(exposure_filter)) {
    if ("hiv_exposure_risk" %in% names(plot_data)) {
      plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
        filter(hiv_exposure_risk == exposure_filter)
    } else {
      warning("hiv_exposure_risk variable not found in dataset")
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(gender_filter)) {
    if ("gender" %in% names(plot_data)) {
      plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
        filter(gender == gender_filter)
    } else {
      warning("gender variable not found in dataset")
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(region_birth_filter)) {
    if ("region_birth" %in% names(plot_data)) {
      plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
        filter(region_birth == region_birth_filter)
    } else {
      warning("region_birth variable not found in dataset")
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(lang_home_filter)) {
    if ("lang_home" %in% names(plot_data)) {
      plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
        filter(lang_home == lang_home_filter)
    } else {
      warning("lang_home variable not found in dataset")
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(place_acq_filter)) {
    if ("place_acq" %in% names(plot_data)) {
      plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
        filter(place_acq == place_acq_filter)
    } else {
      warning("place_acq variable not found in dataset")
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(state_res_filter)) {
    if ("state_res" %in% names(plot_data)) {
      plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
        filter(state_res == state_res_filter)
    } else {
      warning("state_res variable not found in dataset")
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(phn_res_filter)) {
    if ("phn_res" %in% names(plot_data)) {
      plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
        filter(phn_res == phn_res_filter)
    } else {
      warning("phn_res variable not found in dataset")
    }
  }
  
  # Check if we have data left after all the filtering
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    stop("No data remaining after applying all filters. Please adjust your filter criteria.")
  }
  
  # Aggregate data by year for plotting
  summary_data <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(!!sym(year_var)) %>%
    summarise(
      total_notifications = n(),
      late_diag_count = sum(!!sym(late_diag_var), na.rm = TRUE),
      late_diag_prop = mean(!!sym(late_diag_var), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # Convert proportion to percentage
    mutate(late_diag_percent = late_diag_prop * 100)
  
  # Get y-axis ranges
  max_notifications <- max(summary_data$total_notifications)
  max_notifications_rounded <- ceiling(max_notifications / 50) * 50  # Round up to nearest 50
  
  # Calculate the appropriate scaling factor for the right axis (late diagnosis proportion)
  # We want to ensure the right axis always shows 0-100% range
  # We calculate what value on the left axis corresponds to 100% on the right axis
  right_axis_max <- max_notifications_rounded
  scale_factor <- right_axis_max / 100
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = !!sym(year_var))) +
    # Add notification line
    geom_line(aes(y = total_notifications, color = "Notifications"), 
             size = 1.2, group = 1) +
    # Add late diagnosis proportion line
    geom_line(aes(y = late_diag_percent * scale_factor, 
                 color = "Late Diagnosis Proportion"), 
              size = 1.2, group = 2) +
    # Add points to the lines if requested
    {if(add_points) geom_point(aes(y = total_notifications, 
                                  color = "Notifications"), 
                              size = 3)} +
    {if(add_points) geom_point(aes(y = late_diag_percent * scale_factor, 
                                  color = "Late Diagnosis Proportion"), 
                              size = 3)} +
    # Add data labels if requested
    {if(add_labels) geom_text(aes(y = total_notifications, 
                                 label = total_notifications),
                             vjust = -0.5, 
                             color = "black", 
                             size = 3.5)} +
    {if(add_labels) geom_text(aes(y = late_diag_percent * scale_factor,
                                 label = paste0(round(late_diag_percent, 1), "%")),
                             vjust = -0.8, 
                             color = "black", 
                             size = 3.5)} +
    # Set scales
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Number of Notifications",
      limits = c(0, max_notifications_rounded * 1.15),  # Add 15% padding at top
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, 
                          name = "Late Diagnosis Proportion (%)",
                          labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
                          breaks = seq(0, 100, 20))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = unique(summary_data[[year_var]]),
      labels = unique(summary_data[[year_var]]),
      name = "Year"
    ) +
    # Set colors for both lines
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "",
      values = c(
        "Notifications" = notification_color,
        "Late Diagnosis Proportion" = late_diag_color
      )
    ) +
    # Add labels
    labs(
      title = main_title,
      subtitle = subtitle
    ) +
    # Theme customization
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = legend_position,
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90"),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "gray80"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      # Clean white background
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      # Reasonable margins
      plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 30, b = 20, l = 20, unit = "pt"),
      # Combine legends for line and bars
      legend.box = "horizontal"
    )
  
  return(p)
}


####Run the function to generate the line plot####
# Basic usage with all data
all_data_lineplot <- create_dual_line_plot(
  data = hiv_data,
  main_title = "HIV Notifications and Late Diagnosis Proportion"
)
all_data_lineplot

  start_year = 2020,
  end_year = 2023,

  region_birth_filter = NULL,   # region_birth

  place_acq_filter = NULL,      # place_acq
  state_res_filter = NULL,      # state_res
  phn_res_filter = NULL,        # phn_res
  main_title = "HIV Notifications and Late Diagnosis Among MSM",
  subtitle = "2020-2023"
)
msm_lineplot

}
```

```{r Trend Analysis Functions}
#### Export results to CSV files ####
# Function to combine results across populations
combine_segmented_results <- function(results_list, population_labels) {
  
  # 1. Combine segment_results
  segment_combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(results_list), function(i) {
    df <- results_list[[i]]$segment_results
    if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
      df$Population <- population_labels[i]
      df
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }))
  
  # Reorder columns to put Population first
  if (!is.null(segment_combined)) {
    segment_combined <- segment_combined[, c("Population", setdiff(names(segment_combined), "Population"))]
  }
  
  # 2. Combine bic_candidates
  bic_combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(results_list), function(i) {
    df <- results_list[[i]]$bic_candidates
    if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
      df$Population <- population_labels[i]
      df
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }))
  
  if (!is.null(bic_combined)) {
    bic_combined <- bic_combined[, c("Population", setdiff(names(bic_combined), "Population"))]
  }
  
  # 3. Combine change_points
  change_points_combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(results_list), function(i) {
    df <- results_list[[i]]$change_points
    if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
      df$Population <- population_labels[i]
      df
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }))
  
  if (!is.null(change_points_combined)) {
    change_points_combined <- change_points_combined[, c("Population", setdiff(names(change_points_combined), "Population"))]
  }
  
  # 4. Combine wald_adjacent_slopes
  wald_combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(results_list), function(i) {
    df <- results_list[[i]]$wald_adjacent_slopes
    if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
      df$Population <- population_labels[i]
      df
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }))
  
  if (!is.null(wald_combined)) {
    wald_combined <- wald_combined[, c("Population", setdiff(names(wald_combined), "Population"))]
  }
  
  # 5. Combine overall_summary (AAPC)
  overall_summary_combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(results_list), function(i) {
    df <- results_list[[i]]$overall_summary
    if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
      df$Population <- population_labels[i]
      df[, c("Population", setdiff(names(df), "Population"))]
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }))
  
  return(list(
    segment_results = segment_combined,
    bic_candidates = bic_combined,
    change_points = change_points_combined,
    wald_adjacent_slopes = wald_combined,
    overall_summary = overall_summary_combined
  ))
}

# 2. Export segment results (trends for each segment)
if (!is.null(segmented_results$segment_results) && nrow(segmented_results$segment_results) > 0) {
  write.csv(segmented_results$segment_results,
            file = file.path(results_dir, "segment_trends.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Exported segment trends table to CSV\n")
}

# 3. Export Davies test results
if (!is.null(segmented_results$davies_test) && nrow(segmented_results$davies_test) > 0) {
  write.csv(segmented_results$davies_test,
            file = file.path(results_dir, "davies_test.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Exported Davies test results to CSV\n")
}

# 4. Export BIC comparison
if (!is.null(segmented_results$bic_comparison) && nrow(segmented_results$bic_comparison) > 0) {
  write.csv(segmented_results$bic_comparison,
            file = file.path(results_dir, "bic_comparison.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Exported BIC comparison to CSV\n")
}

# 5. Export overall trend results
if (!is.null(segmented_results$overall_results$overall_results) && 
    nrow(segmented_results$overall_results$overall_results) > 0) {
  write.csv(segmented_results$overall_results$overall_results,
            file = file.path(results_dir, "overall_trend.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Exported overall trend results to CSV\n")
}

# 6. Export trend data (the actual data points used for analysis)
if (!is.null(segmented_results$overall_results$trend_data) && 
    nrow(segmented_results$overall_results$trend_data) > 0) {
  write.csv(segmented_results$overall_results$trend_data,
            file = file.path(results_dir, "trend_data.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Exported trend data to CSV\n")
}

# Create a summary table with key results
# Combine important statistics from various tables
if (!is.null(segmented_results$davies_test) && !is.null(segmented_results$segment_results)) {
  # Number of change points
  num_changes <- nrow(segmented_results$change_points)
  
  # Davies test p-value
  davies_pvalue <- segmented_results$davies_test$P_value[1]
  
  # BIC difference (if available)
  bic_diff <- NA
  if (!is.null(segmented_results$bic_comparison) && nrow(segmented_results$bic_comparison) > 1) {
    bic_diff <- segmented_results$bic_comparison$BIC_Difference[2]
  }
  
  # Segment trends (simplified)
  segment_trends <- paste(segmented_results$segment_results$Interpretation, collapse = " → ")
  
  # Create summary table
  summary_table <- data.frame(
    Analysis_Type = "Segmented Trend Analysis",
    Count_Period = segmented_results$parameters$count_period,
    Start_Year = segmented_results$parameters$start_year,
    End_Year = segmented_results$parameters$end_year,
    Number_of_Change_Points = num_changes,
    Davies_Test_Pvalue = davies_pvalue,
    BIC_Difference = bic_diff,
    Segment_Trends = segment_trends
  )
  
  # Add any filters that were applied
  if (!is.null(segmented_results$parameters$exposure_filter)) {
    summary_table$Exposure_Filter <- segmented_results$parameters$exposure_filter
  }
  
  if (!is.null(segmented_results$parameters$gender_filter)) {
    summary_table$Gender_Filter <- segmented_results$parameters$gender_filter
  }
  
  # Export summary table
  write.csv(summary_table,
            file = file.path(results_dir, "analysis_summary.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Exported analysis summary to CSV\n")
}

cat("\nExport complete. All files saved to:", results_dir, "\n")
```

```{r timeseries plot for phn}
hiv_cases_yearly <- hiv_data_filtered %>%

  )

# Step 4: Join HIV cases with population data and calculate rates
hiv_case_rates <- phn_pop_yearly %>%
  left_join(hiv_cases_yearly, by = c("PHN_CODE", "PHN_NAME", "year")) %>%
  mutate(
    hiv_cases = ifelse(is.na(hiv_cases), 0, hiv_cases),
    case_rate_per_100k = (hiv_cases / total_pop) * 100000
  ) %>%
  # Filter out any PHNs with zero population (data quality check)
  filter(total_pop > 0)

hiv_case_rates_fed <- hiv_case_rates

# PHN-level trend analysis: case_rate_per_100k ~ year
phn_case_trend <- hiv_case_rates_fed %>%
  filter(year %in% 2001:2024) %>%     # adjust years as needed
  group_by(PHN_CODE, PHN_NAME) %>%
  do(tidy(lm(case_rate_per_100k ~ year, data = .))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(term == "year") %>%
  select(PHN_CODE, PHN_NAME, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value) %>%
  rename(
    slope   = estimate,   # absolute change in rate per 100k per year
    se      = std.error,
    t_value = statistic,
    p_value = p.value
  )

phn_baseline_rate <- hiv_case_rates_fed %>%
  filter(year %in% 2001:2024) %>%
  group_by(PHN_CODE, PHN_NAME) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_year = min(year),
    baseline_rate = case_rate_per_100k[which.min(year)],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

phn_case_trend <- phn_case_trend %>%
  left_join(phn_baseline_rate, by = c("PHN_CODE", "PHN_NAME")) %>%
  mutate(
    # Annual % change relative to baseline rate
    annual_percent_change = if_else(
      baseline_rate > 0,
      (slope / baseline_rate) * 100,
      NA_real_
    ),
    # 95% CI for slope, then convert to % of baseline
    apc_lower = if_else(
      baseline_rate > 0,
      ((slope - 1.96 * se) / baseline_rate) * 100,
      NA_real_
    ),
    apc_upper = if_else(
      baseline_rate > 0,
      ((slope + 1.96 * se) / baseline_rate) * 100,
      NA_real_
    ),
    # Trend category (direction + significance)
    trend_category = case_when(
      p_value < 0.05 & annual_percent_change > 0  ~ "Increasing",
      p_value < 0.05 & annual_percent_change < 0  ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE                                        ~ "Stable"
    )
  )

phn_case_trend_final <- phn_case_trend %>%
  mutate(
    annual_percent_change = round(annual_percent_change, 1),
    ci_95 = sprintf("%.1f to %.1f", apc_lower, apc_upper),
    apc_with_ci = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f to %.1f)",
                          annual_percent_change, apc_lower,
                          apc_upper),
    p_value = round(p_value, 3)
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    PHN_CODE,
    PHN_NAME,
    annual_percent_change,
    ci_95,
    apc_with_ci,
    p_value,
    trend_category
  )

phn_case_trend_final_fed <- phn_case_trend_final

  ) %>%

# Step 2: Calculate PHN population for each year
phn_pop_yearly <- pop_sa2_long %>%
  inner_join(phn_lookup, by = "SA2_CODE21",relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(
    pop_alloc = pop_size * RATIO_FROM_TO
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(PHN_CODE)) %>%

# Step 3: Calculate HIV cases by PHN and year
hiv_cases_yearly <- hiv_data_filtered %>%
  group_by(phn_res, phn_name, year_diag) %>%
  summarise(
    hiv_cases = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    PHN_CODE = phn_res,
    PHN_NAME = phn_name,
    year = year_diag
  )

# Step 4: Join HIV cases with population data and calculate rates
hiv_case_rates <- phn_pop_yearly %>%
  left_join(hiv_cases_yearly, by = c("PHN_CODE", "PHN_NAME", "year")) %>%
  mutate(
    hiv_cases = ifelse(is.na(hiv_cases), 0, hiv_cases),
    case_rate_per_100k = (hiv_cases / total_pop) * 100000
  ) %>%
  # Filter out any PHNs with zero population (data quality check)
  filter(total_pop > 0)

hiv_case_rates_pdo <- hiv_case_rates

# PHN-level trend analysis: case_rate_per_100k ~ year
phn_case_trend_pdo <- hiv_case_rates_pdo %>%
  filter(year %in% 2001:2024) %>%     # adjust years as needed
  group_by(PHN_CODE, PHN_NAME) %>%
  do(tidy(lm(case_rate_per_100k ~ year, data = .))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(term == "year") %>%
  select(PHN_CODE, PHN_NAME, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value) %>%
  rename(
    slope   = estimate,   # absolute change in rate per 100k per year
    se      = std.error,
    t_value = statistic,
    p_value = p.value
  )

phn_baseline_rate_pdo <- hiv_case_rates_pdo %>%
  filter(year %in% 2001:2024) %>%
  group_by(PHN_CODE, PHN_NAME) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_year = min(year),
    baseline_rate = case_rate_per_100k[which.min(year)],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

phn_case_trend_pdo <- phn_case_trend_pdo %>%
  left_join(phn_baseline_rate_pdo, by = c("PHN_CODE", "PHN_NAME")) %>%
  mutate(
    # Annual % change relative to baseline rate
    annual_percent_change = if_else(
      baseline_rate > 0,
      (slope / baseline_rate) * 100,
      NA_real_
    ),
    # 95% CI for slope, then convert to % of baseline
    apc_lower = if_else(
      baseline_rate > 0,
      ((slope - 1.96 * se) / baseline_rate) * 100,
      NA_real_
    ),
    apc_upper = if_else(
      baseline_rate > 0,
      ((slope + 1.96 * se) / baseline_rate) * 100,
      NA_real_
    ),
    # Trend category (direction + significance)
    trend_category = case_when(
      p_value < 0.05 & slope > 0  ~ "Increasing",
      p_value < 0.05 & slope < 0  ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE                                        ~ "Stable"
    )
  )

phn_case_trend_final_pdo <- phn_case_trend_pdo %>%
  mutate(
    annual_percent_change = round(annual_percent_change, 1),
    ci_95 = sprintf("%.1f to %.1f", apc_lower, apc_upper),
    apc_with_ci = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f to %.1f)",
                          annual_percent_change, apc_lower,
                          apc_upper),
    p_value = round(p_value, 3)
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    PHN_CODE,
    PHN_NAME,
    annual_percent_change,
    ci_95,
    apc_with_ci,
    p_value,
    trend_category
  )

#### Gini coefficient plot ####
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)


# Weighted Gini computation
weighted_gini <- function(x, w) {
  # Remove NAs
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(w)
  x <- x[ok]
  w <- w[ok]
  
  # Order by x ascending (low to high)
  ord <- order(x)
  x <- x[ord]
  w <- w[ord]
  
  # Cumulative weighted proportions - include (0,0) point
  cw <- c(0, cumsum(w) / sum(w))
  px <- c(0, cumsum(w * x) / sum(w * x))
  
  # Numerical integration (trapezoid rule)
  # Area under Lorenz curve
  area <- sum((px[-1] + px[-length(px)]) / 2 * diff(cw))
  
  # Gini coefficient
  G <- 1 - 2 * area
  
  return(G)
}

phn_gini_trend <- hiv_case_rates_fed %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    gini_weighted = weighted_gini(case_rate_per_100k, total_pop),
    mean_rate     = mean(case_rate_per_100k, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rate       = sd(case_rate_per_100k, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

phn_gini_overall_trend <- lm(gini_weighted ~ year, data = phn_gini_trend)
summary(phn_gini_overall_trend)

gini_time_plot <- ggplot(phn_gini_trend, aes(x = year, y = gini_weighted)) +
  geom_line(color = "#1f77b4", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#1f77b4", size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2001, 2024, 3)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +   # y-axis starts at 0
  labs(
    title = "",
    y = "Gini Index",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),     # remove major gridlines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),     # remove minor gridlines
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),  # add black x & y axes
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"), # add tick marks
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  )


plot_phn_lorenz <- function(hiv_case_rates_fed, phn_map, year_selected = 2001,
                            label_left = c("Perth North", "South Western Sydney", "Adelaide"),
                            label_right = c("Central and Eastern Sydney"),label_lefttop = c(),sub_title = "") {

  # Prepare data
  data_year <- hiv_case_rates_fed %>%
    filter(year == year_selected, total_pop > 0) %>%
    left_join(phn_map %>% select(PHN_CODE, STATE), by = "PHN_CODE") %>%
    arrange(case_rate_per_100k) %>%
    mutate(
      cum_pop = cumsum(total_pop),
      cum_cases = cumsum(hiv_cases),
      prop_pop = cum_pop / sum(total_pop, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_cases = cum_cases / sum(hiv_cases, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  # Compute Gini
  gini_val <- weighted_gini(data_year$case_rate_per_100k, data_year$total_pop)

  # Prepare labels
  lefttop_labels <- data_year %>% filter(PHN_NAME %in% label_lefttop) %>%
    mutate(
      x_text = prop_pop - 0.03,
      y_text = prop_cases + 0.03
    )
  left_labels <- data_year %>% filter(PHN_NAME %in% label_left) %>%
    mutate(
      x_text = prop_pop - 0.03,
      y_text = prop_cases 
    )  
  right_labels <- data_year %>% filter(PHN_NAME %in% label_right) %>%
    mutate(
      x_text = prop_pop + 0.03,
      y_text = prop_cases - 0.03
    )

  #
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +

    # Colored step segments by state
    geom_segment(data = data_year,
                 aes(x = lag(prop_pop, default = 0),
                     y = lag(prop_cases, default = 0),
                     xend = prop_pop,
                     yend = lag(prop_cases, default = 0),
                     color = STATE), linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_segment(data = data_year,
                 aes(x = prop_pop,
                     y = lag(prop_cases, default = 0),
                     xend = prop_pop,
                     yend = prop_cases,
                     color = STATE), linewidth = 0.5) +

    scale_color_manual(values = state_cols) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05),
                       breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
                       labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05),
                       breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
                       labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(""),
      subtitle = paste0(sub_title,"Notifications (",year_selected,"); Gini index: ", round(gini_val, 3)),
      x = "Cumulative proportion of population",
      y = "Cumulative proportion of notifications",
      color = "State/Territory"
    ) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 50, b = 10, l = 10),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 12),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1, clip = "off")

  # Add label connectors and text
if (nrow(left_labels)) {
  p <- p +
    geom_segment(
      data = left_labels,
      aes(x = x_text, y = y_text, xend = prop_pop, yend = prop_cases),
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_label(
      data = left_labels,
      aes(x = x_text, y = y_text, label = PHN_NAME),
      hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 3,
      fill = "white",        # White background behind label text
      label.size = 0         # No border line
    )
}

if (nrow(lefttop_labels)) {
  p <- p +
    geom_segment(
      data = lefttop_labels,
      aes(x = x_text, y = y_text, xend = prop_pop, yend = prop_cases),
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_label(
      data = lefttop_labels,
      aes(x = x_text, y = y_text, label = PHN_NAME),
      hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 3,
      fill = "white",        # White background behind label text
      label.size = 0         # No border line
    )
}  
  
if (nrow(right_labels)) {
  p <- p +
    geom_segment(
      data = right_labels,
      aes(x = x_text, y = y_text, xend = prop_pop, yend = prop_cases),
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_label(
      data = right_labels,
      aes(x = x_text, y = y_text, label = PHN_NAME),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3,
      fill = "white",        # White background behind text
      label.size = 0         # Removes border box outline
    )
}

  return(list(plot = p, gini = gini_val, data = data_year))
}

#### Average CD4 count (First ever diagnosed in Australia) ####
# Filter
cd4_data_filtered <- hiv_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    year_diag >= 2001,
    year_diag <= 2024,
    !is.na(phn_res),
    !is.na(year_diag),
    previ_diag_overseas == 0
  )

# Optional small-cell masking threshold (set to 1 to effectively disable)
min_n <- 1

# Mean CD4 by PHN x year (and sample size) 
cd4_mean_yearly <- cd4_data_filtered %>%
  dplyr::group_by(PHN_CODE = phn_res, PHN_NAME = phn_name, year = year_diag) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_cd4 = mean(cd4_count_diag, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(cd4_count_diag)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_cd4 = ifelse(n < min_n, NA_real_, mean_cd4)  # mask small cells
  )

# Complete grid to ensure rectangular heatmap
all_phn_years <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  PHN_NAME = ordered_names,
  year = 2001:2024
)

cd4_heatmap_df <- all_phn_years %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    cd4_mean_yearly %>% dplyr::select(PHN_NAME, year, mean_cd4),
    by = c("PHN_NAME", "year")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    phn_map %>% dplyr::select(PHN_NAME, STATE, code_num),
    by = "PHN_NAME"
  )

# Limits & breaks: lower from data (rounded), upper fixed at 500; squish >500 to top color 
cd4_min <- suppressWarnings(min(cd4_heatmap_df$mean_cd4, na.rm = TRUE))
cd4_low <- if (is.finite(cd4_min)) floor(cd4_min / 50) * 50 else 0
cd4_high <- 500
if (cd4_low >= cd4_high) cd4_low <- cd4_high - 50  # safety if all values >= 500

cd4_limits <- c(cd4_low, cd4_high)
cd4_breaks <- unique(sort(c(pretty(cd4_limits, n = 5), cd4_high)))
label_ge500 <- function(x) ifelse(x == cd4_high, "≥500", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 0))

scale_colors <- c("#FFFFCC", "#C7E9B4", "#7FCDBB", "#41B6C4", "#1D91C0", "#225EA8", "#0C2C84", "#081D58")

# Plot: mean CD4 heatmap with palette & state legend stacked under colorbar
p_cd4_mean_fed <- ggplot(
  cd4_heatmap_df,
  aes(x = year, y = factor(PHN_NAME, levels = rev(ordered_names)), fill = mean_cd4)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = scale_colors,          # palette
    limits = cd4_limits,            # lower data-driven, upper fixed at 500
    oob = scales::squish,           # >500 uses top color
    na.value = "grey92",
    breaks = cd4_breaks,
    labels = label_ge500,
    name = "Mean CD4\n(cells/μL)"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    limits = rev(ordered_names),
    labels = y_labels[rev(ordered_names)]   # state-colored y labels
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2001, 2024, by = 5)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.box.just = "left",
    legend.spacing.y = unit(4, "pt"),
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.justification = "top"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    subtitle = "Mean CD4 at diagnosis, First ever diagnosed in Australia, 2001–2024",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Primary Health Network" #,
#    caption = paste0("Cells with n<", min_n, " masked as NA (shown in grey).")
  ) +
  # Milestones
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2020, lwd = 1.2, color = "#cf0a66") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2016, lwd = 1.2, color = "#cf0a66")

#### Composite Index for Late Diagnosis ####
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Step 1: define all PHNs and all years
all_phns  <- unique(na.omit(hiv_data$phn_name))
all_years <- 2001:2024

# Step 2: full grid of PHN × year
phn_year_full <- expand.grid(
  phn_name = all_phns,
  year_diag = all_years,
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Step 3: summarise actual data
phn_year_summary <- hiv_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(phn_name),
         !is.na(late_hiv_diag_flag),
         year_diag >= 2001, year_diag <= 2024,
         previ_diag_overseas == 0) %>%
  group_by(year_diag, phn_name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_cases = n(),
    late_diagnoses = sum(late_hiv_diag_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 4: join with full grid and replace NAs with 0
phn_year_summary <- phn_year_full %>%
  left_join(phn_year_summary, by = c("year_diag", "phn_name")) %>%
  mutate(
    total_cases = ifelse(is.na(total_cases), 0, total_cases),
    late_diagnoses = ifelse(is.na(late_diagnoses), 0, late_diagnoses)
  )

# Step 5: compute per-year totals and normalization denominator
yearly_totals <- phn_year_summary %>%
  group_by(year_diag) %>%
  summarise(total_late_year = sum(late_diagnoses, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

max_total_all <- max(yearly_totals$total_late_year, na.rm = TRUE)

# Step 6: compute ranges and weights
range_prop <- max(ifelse(phn_year_summary$total_cases > 0, 
                         phn_year_summary$late_diagnoses / phn_year_summary$total_cases, 0)) -
              min(ifelse(phn_year_summary$total_cases > 0, 
                         phn_year_summary$late_diagnoses / phn_year_summary$total_cases, 0))

range_norm <- max(phn_year_summary$late_diagnoses / max_total_all, na.rm = TRUE) -
              min(phn_year_summary$late_diagnoses / max_total_all, na.rm = TRUE)

w1 <- range_norm / (range_prop + range_norm)
w2 <- range_prop / (range_prop + range_norm)

# Step 7: compute composite index, setting 0 for total_cases = 0
phn_year_index <- phn_year_summary %>%
  mutate(
    late_prop = ifelse(total_cases == 0, 0, late_diagnoses / total_cases),
    normalized_count = late_diagnoses / max_total_all,
    composite_index = ifelse(total_cases == 0, 0,
                             (w1 * late_prop) + (w2 * normalized_count))
  )

# Optional: inspect results
top_phn_each_year <- phn_year_index %>%
  group_by(year_diag) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = composite_index, n = 1) %>%
  select(year_diag, phn_name, composite_index)

yearly_composite_summary <- phn_year_index %>%
  group_by(year_diag) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_index = mean(composite_index, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_index = median(composite_index, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# View results
yearly_composite_summary
median(yearly_composite_summary$mean_index)

library(dplyr)

  geom_point(aes(y = mean_index), color = "#1f78b4", size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(aes(y = mean_index), method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +

# phn level trend analysis
library(dplyr)
library(broom)

# Fit linear model per PHN: composite_index ~ year_diag
phn_overall_trend <- phn_year_index %>%
  filter(year_diag %in% c(2001:2024))  %>%
  group_by(phn_name) %>%
  do(tidy(lm(composite_index ~ year_diag, data = .))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Keep only slope term (year_diag)
phn_overall_trend <- phn_overall_trend %>%
  dplyr::filter(term == "year_diag") %>%
  dplyr::select(phn_name, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value) %>%
  rename(
    slope = estimate,
    se = std.error,
    t_value = statistic,
    p_value = p.value
  )

phn_overall_trend <- phn_overall_trend %>%
  mutate(
    trend_category = case_when(
      p_value < 0.05 & slope > 0 ~ "Increasing",
      p_value < 0.05 & slope < 0 ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE ~ "Stable"
    )
  )

# Summary table
phn_overall_trend %>%
  count(trend_category)

phn_year_index <- phn_year_index %>%
  left_join(
    phn_overall_trend %>% dplyr::select(phn_name, trend_category),
    by = "phn_name"
  )

ggplot(phn_year_index, aes(x = year_diag, y = composite_index, group = phn_name, color = trend_category)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Overall PHN Trends in Late HIV Diagnosis Composite Index (2001–2024)",
    x = "Year", y = "Composite Index"
  )

#### Ranking PHNs by Composite Index ####
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Step 1: Calculate yearly rankings
phn_yearly_ranks <- phn_year_index %>%
  group_by(year_diag) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = rank(-composite_index, ties.method = "min"),
    percentile = percent_rank(-composite_index)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 2: Identify persistently high-ranked PHNs
persistent_high_rank <- phn_yearly_ranks %>%
  group_by(phn_name) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rank = mean(rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rank = median(rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_index = mean(composite_index, na.rm = TRUE),
    years_in_top5 = sum(rank <= 5, na.rm = TRUE),
    years_in_top10 = sum(rank <= 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_rank)

print("PHNs with best average rankings:")
print(head(persistent_high_rank, 10))

    breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20),
    labels = c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20),
    name = "Cases per\n100,000"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "HIV Notification Rates by Primary Health Network",
    subtitle = "Notifications per 100,000 population, 2001-2024",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Primary Health Network"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2001, 2024, by = 5)) +
  # Add vertical lines for significant HIV milestones
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2020, lwd = 1.2, color = "#0072B2") +  # PrEP approval
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2016, lwd = 1.2, color = "#0072B2")    # UNAIDS 90-90-90 targets

# Display the plot
print(p_timeseries_phn_2001_24_20250901_viridis)

#### Cases heatmap by PHN (not rate) ####
# Prepare the data for heatmap
hiv_df <- hiv_data %>%
  # Filter out cases with missing PHN information
  filter(!is.na(phn_res), !is.na(year_diag)) %>%
  # Group by PHN and year, count cases
  group_by(phn_name, year_diag) %>%
  summarise(cases = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Rename columns to match the measles structure
  rename(country = phn_name, year = year_diag) %>%
  # Calculate case rate
  mutate(case_rate = cases)

# Create log-transformed case rate
hiv_df$case_rate_log <- log10(hiv_df$case_rate + 1)  # +1 to avoid log(0)

# Define breaks and colors 
# Modify these breaks based on actual HIV case numbers
scale_breaks <- c(0, 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 200)
scale_colors <- c("#FFFFCC", "#C7E9B4", "#7FCDBB", "#41B6C4", "#1D91C0", "#225EA8", "#0C2C84", "#081D58")

# Transformed breaks for legend positions
log_breaks <- log10(scale_breaks + 1)  # same +1 offset

# Create the heatmap
p <- ggplot(hiv_df, aes(x = year, y = country, fill = case_rate_log)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = scale_colors,
    values = rescale(log_breaks),  # evenly spaced in log space
    breaks = log_breaks,
    labels = scale_breaks,
    name = "HIV Cases"
  ) +
  # Use a standard theme if theme_owid_combined() is not available
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "HIV Cases by Primary Health Network (PHN)",
    subtitle = "Number of HIV diagnoses per year by PHN region",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Primary Health Network"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  # Add vertical lines for significant events (adjust years as appropriate for HIV)
  # These are examples - can modify based on relevant HIV policy/treatment milestones
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2012, lwd = 1.2, color = "#cf0a66") +  # PrEP trials/approval
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2016, lwd = 1.2, color = "#cf0a66")    # UNAIDS 90-90-90 targets

# Display the plot
p

# Save the plot
ggsave("output/hiv_phn_heatmap.pdf", plot = p, width = 18, height = 12, units = "in", dpi = 1200)

# Optional: Print summary statistics
cat("HIV Data Summary:\n")
cat("Total PHNs:", length(unique(hiv_df$country)), "\n")
cat("Year range:", min(hiv_df$year), "-", max(hiv_df$year), "\n")
cat("Total cases:", sum(hiv_df$cases), "\n")
cat("Mean cases per PHN per year:", round(mean(hiv_df$cases), 2), "\n")

####save figure####
SaveFigure <- function(folder, filename, figure, 
    format = ".png", width = 25, 
    height = 12.5, units = "cm", dpi = 600,...) {
    ggsave(file.path(folder, paste(filename, format, sep = "")), 
      plot = figure, width = width, height = height, units = units,dpi=dpi, ...)
}

# If figure not already created make sure it is not overwritten
if (!file.exists(file.path(figFolder, "p_timeseries_phn_2001_24_20250902_viridis.png"))) {
    SaveFigure(figFolder,"p_timeseries_phn_2001_24_20250902_viridis", p_timeseries_phn_2001_24_20250901_viridis)
}

if (!file.exists(file.path(figFolder, "p_timeseries_phn_2001_24_20250902_gradient.png"))) {
    SaveFigure(figFolder,"p_timeseries_phn_2001_24_20250902_gradient", p_timeseries_phn_2001_24_20250901_gradient)
}
```
